questions.stem: What is the role of the acrosome in fertilisation?

options.text: It provides energy for the sperm to swim
It contains enzymes that digest the outer layer of the egg
It stores the genetic material of the sperm
It produces hormones to attract the egg

questions.explanation: The acrosome is a structure at the tip of the sperm head that contains digestive enzymes. These enzymes break down the outer layer of the egg cell, allowing the sperm to penetrate and fuse with the egg.
